title: Debounce and throttle
summary: Implement debounce (run after input stops for an interval) and throttle (run at most once per interval) for search-as-you-type.
approach: Debounce: cancel the previous pending `Task` and start a new one that sleeps then runs. Throttle: remember the last fire time and drop calls inside the window.
body: SwiftUI shortcut: `.task(id: query) { try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(300)); await search(query) }` debounces because changing `id` cancels the previous task.
Also cancel the in-flight network request so stale results never overwrite newer ones.
